description: Unified dispatcher + in-dome / subcooled / superheated-vapour solvers, validated vs Moody(1975), Zaloudek, Marviken. All stagnation buckets + the near-bubble-point x~0 artifact fixed. Only known discrepancy: isobar_pref_0_25 (p0=1.72 bar) #[ignore]d (IAPWS isentrope vs incompressible-Bernoulli at extreme pressure ratio).
title: Choked-flow (HEM) multiphase critical-flow solvers

description: Milestone 2: body-fit a closed surface into a volume mesh, cfMesh cartesianMesh castellation step (minus octree refinement + snapping, deferred). carve_box(points, tris, cell_size) -> VolumeMesh: overlay a uniform Cartesian grid on the surface bbox, keep cells whose centre is inside (ray-parity / Moeller-Trumbore inside test against the triangle soup), build the VolumeMesh of kept cells (internal faces between two kept cells, boundary faces = the carved staircase surface in a 'walls' patch), compact points+cells. v1 = staircase boundary (no surface snapping yet); pure Rust, self-contained (takes a triangle soup, no blender dep). V&V: grid-aligned box carves exactly (exact volume, watertight, validate ok); a triangulated sphere carves to ~ (4/3) pi r^3 within staircase tolerance and validate() closed.
title: cfmesh: castellated Cartesian carve of a closed surface (port milestone 2)
